fld_description: Natural cruise key in YYYY-MM-NODC form.
notes: Source is bare YYMM (e.g. 1202). Ship is RV New Horizon (NODC 32NM) for all 7 cruises 1001/1008/1011/1101/1108/1110/1202 -- established during drafting by a one-time manual cross-check against calcofi_bottle Cast table (cruise+station+lat/lon overlap), hardcoded here as a constant, not a runtime join.

fld_description: Sequential MOHT tow number within the cruise.
Packed line/station value, kept verbatim as source-provided -- NOT decomposed into site_key.
notes: Decomposition is unreliable: CalCOFI standard lines are non-integer (93.3, 86.7, 76.7, not 93/87/77) and some stations are 3-digit with a trailing zero lost to Excel float storage (source string '93.120' vs float 93.11, ambiguous as station 120 vs 11). site_key is resolved separately via a spatial match instead (see the site_key row below and questions.csv Q05, RESOLVED) -- this field stays as the verbatim source value for auditing, never itself decomposed.

fld_description: Latitude in decimal degrees WGS84.
Longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (source is positive west; negate).
notes: Source stores unsigned degrees-west; must negate to standard WGS84 sign.

fld_description: Calendar month of the tow, as provided by the source.
notes: Retained for QA alongside the new datetime_start_utc (Q03 RESOLVED via the workbook's 'Original' sheet -- see the Time row below and questions.csv Q03).

fld_description: Calendar year of the tow, as provided by the source.
notes: Retained for QA alongside datetime_start_utc, see tow_month note

fld_description: Tow hour (24hr clock), split from source HH.MM Time value (e.g. 23.57 -> hour 23).
notes: Confirmed HH.MM format against source Header Definitions sheet. Retained for QA -- datetime_start_utc (below) is now the authoritative timing field, sourced from 'Original' sheet's Start hour except for cruise 1110 (unresolved +1hr conflict, defaults to this Sheet1 value -- see questions.csv Q03/Q06).

fld_description: Tow minute, split from source HH.MM Time value (e.g. 23.57 -> minute 57).
notes: Retained for QA only -- confirmed unreliable standalone: 21 of 102 rows have a single-digit-minute decimal-entry typo in this field specifically (e.g. '12.5' meant 12:05, parses to minute=50). datetime_start_utc uses 'Original' sheet's Start Minute instead, which does not have this defect. See questions.csv Q03.

fld_description: Calendar date of the tow, from the workbook's 'Original' (raw field log) sheet -- not present in Sheet1 at all.
notes: Resolves Q03 (previously blocked: no Day column anywhere thought to exist in the source). Joined to Sheet1 by CruiseID+Tow.

fld_description: Tow start time as separate integer fields, from the 'Original' sheet.
notes: More reliable than Sheet1's packed HH.MM Time -- see tow_minute note above. Used directly except for cruise 1110's hour, where an unresolved +1hr conflict against Sheet1 exists (questions.csv Q06, new).

units: Explicit PST/PDT per tow from the 'Original' sheet -- genuinely DST-aware, not assumed.
mutation: Not stored as its own column; used only to cross-validate the America/Los_Angeles tz conversion (agreed in every row sampled). Resolves the UTC-vs-local half of Q03.

fld_description: Full tow start datetime in UTC, assembled from 'Original' sheet's Date of Tow + Start hour/minute, converted via America/Los_Angeles tz.
notes: NEW field, resolves Q03. NULL only for tows with no 'Original' sheet match (none observed in the 102 rows checked). hour_source_conflict flags the 15 cruise-1110 rows with the unresolved hour discrepancy -- see questions.csv Q06.

fld_description: TRUE for the 15 cruise-1110 (2011-10) tows where Sheet1's Time and Original's Start hour disagree by exactly 1 hour (minutes agree). FALSE/NULL elsewhere.
notes: NEW field. Not a data-quality flag on the other 101 tows -- specific to the unresolved 1110 conflict. See questions.csv Q06.

fld_description: Calibrated maximum tow depth.
Volume of water filtered by the MOHT net during the tow.
Total density across all species/unidentified fish for the tow.
notes: Redundant with SUM(mesopelagic_fish_measurement.measurement_value) where measurement_type='density'; keep as a stored total for QC cross-check only, do not treat as authoritative.

fld_description: Total areal abundance across all species/unidentified fish for the tow.
CalCOFI line/station label (e.g. '93.3,120'), resolved via spatial match rather than parsed from station_raw.
notes: NEW field, resolves Q05. Looked up from the same grid reference add_spatial uses for grid_key -- once grid_key is assigned from the tow's own lat/lon, site_key is that cell's line/station labels concatenated. Does not depend on calcofi_bottle at runtime. See questions.csv Q05.

fld_description: Column header taken verbatim as scientific_name pre-WoRMS-match.
notes: 90 named-species columns (e.g. 'Cyclothone acclinidens') plus 'UnidentifiedFish' (91 columns total, verified against the actual xlsx header) pivoted long via species-as-columns -> rows. Needs --has-taxonomy WoRMS matching pass (species_id/worms_id resolution) before release -- not yet run.

fld_description: Raw count of individuals of this taxon in the tow (confirmed via source Header Definitions: "values for the various taxa refer to the numbers in the sample").
notes: measurement_type='abundance'. DensityTotal/Abundance are tow-level totals derived from summed tallies + VolFilt, not per-species -- kept as QC-only totals on mesopelagic_fish_tow, not pivoted per-species.
